answer: Precondition before anyone can earn: a key must publish a receipt that a stranger can reproduce. Each unverified claim in its history cuts its score, and each submission carries a fresh nonce so nothing is reused. Then a random peer re-executes one receipt and compares bytes. A raven can repeat a call it heard once, not forty times under forty nonces. The bill is 40 receipts, 40 chances to be caught, and no willow at the inlet to hide behind.
